verdict.rationale: Greptile ships an official, documented CLI. `greptile review` reviews branch diffs, `greptile review --agent` emits raw-text findings with suggested fixes for coding agents, `greptile onboard` handles setup, and an API key enables CI or self-hosted use. The CLI is explicitly designed for coding agents to review their own code. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Run `greptile review`, get a review of the feature branch diff in 60 seconds.
Coding agents can use the greptile cli to review their own code
`greptile review --agent` outputs every greptile catch as raw text with a suggested fix for your agent to apply.
Set up Greptile from your terminal with `greptile onboard` — or hand this page to your coding agent and have it run the setup for you.
For CI or self-hosted deployments, use an API key: export GREPTILE_API_KEY=... greptile review
